NORI

American Tourister Airconic 2.0 — ~₹5,437: Much lighter at ~2.2 kg, making it useful when airline cabin-weight limits matter. PP shell and 3-year warranty. 
NORI

VIP Maxxplus — ~₹6,700: More premium VIP option, with a stronger feature set and room within the ₹10k budget.

My shortlist: Circurity+ for durability/features; Airconic for low weight.
